benchmark_contract.head_retire: Dispose the N original children in original front-to-back order.

tradeoffs_and_limits: The 2048 promotion threshold retains 1k reorder and 1k-to-2k append/prepend on contiguous storage. It was chosen after the threshold-128 diagnostic regressed small cases; it is not a claim of a universally optimal threshold.

After promotion the index stores only live NodeId keys and current previous/next links. It allocates O(live sibling count) extra storage. A requested contiguous snapshot adds another O(live sibling count) vector. Total allocator/RSS was not measured.
At <=1024 indexed siblings the representation demotes to contiguous storage, releasing the formerly wide hash index. Hysteresis avoids repeated promotion at a single boundary.

Public Deref/AsRef/iter/debug/equality/clone can request the contiguous snapshot. First access after an indexed mutation is O(N); repeated accesses without a mutation reuse it. Reading all children after every mutation can still produce O(N^2) total reads. Required restricted-subtree validation remains unchanged.

HashMap live-ID edits are expected O(1) each, not a worst-case hash-complexity guarantee. Deterministic work assertions count visited/promotion/index operations and prove the removed explicit search/Vec shifts; they do not time hash probing or allocator internals.

Pinned complete-Memory append medians regress by 2.6%, 8.2%, and 4.3% at 1k/10k/50k; these results are retained. Early unpinned ABBA fast-path regressions up to ~187% remain visible and are not erased by later pinned or pure-container results.

Later same-binary/pinned and same-process container diagnostics did not reproduce a uniform twofold fast-path slowdown. Scheduling, heterogeneous cores, and code-layout effects remain possible influences; the measurements do not establish a single cause.

Only removal of the explicit quadratic wide-sibling mutation work is claimed. No universal application speedup, host frame-time benefit, lower memory use, physical focus/selection acceptance, or platform result is inferred.
